promptVersions.body: Change many records here without a file: choose the object, the records and the changes, preview, then run. To start from a saved query, run it on the Find tab and choose Bulk update. Recent bulk updates and deletes, with their undo, are listed below.
promptVersions.description: First visit to the Super Transform tab: bulk changes start here; Find for a saved query; the lists below and their undo.
promptVersions.title: Bulk Changes Start Here
